grid.title: Avaliação de Consumo
grid.expression: SELECT PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, NVL(SUM(EST.ESTOQUE),0) AS ESTOQUE, (SELECT NVL(SUM(ITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.TIPMOV IN ('Q', 'T') AND ITE.CODLOCALORIG = 101 AND ITE.ATUALESTOQUE = -1 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1))) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1)) AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD) AS ANTERIOR1, (SELECT NVL(SUM(ITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.TIPMOV IN ('Q', 'T') AND ITE.CODLOCALORIG = 101 AND ITE.ATUALESTOQUE = -1 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -2))) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -2)) AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD) AS ANTERIOR2, (SELECT NVL(SUM(ITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.TIPMOV IN ('Q', 'T') AND ITE.CODLOCALORIG = 101 AND ITE.ATUALESTOQUE = -1 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -3))) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -3)) AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD) AS ANTERIOR3, (SELECT NVL(SUM(ITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.TIPMOV IN ('Q', 'T') AND ITE.CODLOCALORIG = 101 AND ITE.ATUALESTOQUE = -1 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -4))) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -4)) AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD) AS ANTERIOR4, (SELECT NVL(SUM(ITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.TIPMOV IN ('Q', 'T') AND ITE.CODLOCALORIG = 101 AND ITE.ATUALESTOQUE = -1 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -5))) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -5)) AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD) AS ANTERIOR5, (SELECT NVL(SUM(ITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.TIPMOV IN ('Q', 'T') AND ITE.CODLOCALORIG = 101 AND ITE.ATUALESTOQUE = -1 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -6))) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAB.DTENTSAI) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -6)) AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD) AS ANTERIOR6, NVL(PRO.ESTMIN,0) AS ESTMIN, --(SELECT MAX(Ca.DTENTSAI) FROM TGFCAB Ca INNER JOIN TGFITE It ON Ca.NUNOTA = It.NUNOTA WHERE It.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND Ca.TIPMOV = 'C') AS ULTCOMPRA, (SELECT NVL(SUM(I.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFITE I INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON I.NUNOTA = C.NUNOTA WHERE C.CODTIPOPER IN (SELECT DISTINCT T.CODTIPOPER FROM TGFTOP T WHERE T.GRUPO = 'Pedido Compra') AND C.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND I.PENDENTE = 'S' AND I.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD) AS COMPRA FROM TGFPRO PRO INNER JOIN TGFEST EST ON PRO.CODPROD = EST.CODPROD WHERE EST.CODLOCAL = 101 AND SUBSTR(PRO.CODPROD,1,1) <> 3 AND ((:P_CODGRUPOPROD IS NULL) OR (PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = :P_CODGRUPOPROD)) AND ((:P_CODPROD IS NULL) OR (PRO.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD)) GROUP BY PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, NVL(PRO.ESTMIN,0) ORDER BY PRO.CODPROD
